posts.text: I checked the annual report. Most receivables are less than 6 months old. I think the major reason is the structure of payment with hyperscalers for dc setups. 10 percent advance with orders, 60 percent within 45 days after supply, and I think 10 percent at installation, 10 percent at commissioning and 10 percent a year later. So if the project itself is delayed, even then their payments would be stuck. Not sure about the metro and railway LV and MV panel bills.
